test_case_title: Contact form submits successfully with valid information
test_case_description: Given a visitor opens the contact page, when the visitor fills the form with a full name, email, phone number, and message then submits it, then a success confirmation should be visible and the page must remain stable.
test_case_text: Open the contact page. Fill the contact form with full name, email, phone number, and message. Submit the form. Verify a success message or confirmation appears after submission.
notes: Use this sample to verify that the agent generates a structured form plan, required inputs, and preflight checks instead of a minimal goto-only script.
